title: Surface hunt
offscreen: Run your hand together over three different surfaces (the table, a sweater, the glass) and find a word for each.

items.label: A smooth surface
items.say: Look for a smooth surface and run your hand over it. Then tell me how it feels.

items.label: A rough surface
items.say: Now a rough surface, that scratches a little under your hand.

items.label: A soft surface
items.say: And a soft surface, where your hand sinks in a little.

items.label: A cold surface
items.say: Look for a cold surface, like glass or a tile.

items.label: A surface with bumps
items.say: Now a surface with bumps or lines. Feel it with your fingertips.

items.label: A surface that makes a sound
items.say: And a surface that makes a sound when you stroke it gently.

items.label: Two different surfaces side by side
items.say: Last, two different surfaces next to each other. Tell me how they are different.

intro.bo: {nome}, shall we go on a treasure hunt? You look, I'll wait for you here. One thing at a time.
intro.pilu: {nome}, I'll tell you something to look for. Look carefully around you: treasures are everywhere.
intro.tango: Treasure hunt, {nome}! I'm coming too! ...No, I'll stay here. You look, slowly.

outro.bo: So many treasures, {nome}. Now each one goes back in its place, so we can find them again tomorrow.
outro.pilu: Every treasure goes back where you found it, {nome}: that's part of the game too.
outro.tango: What a hunt! {nome}, shall we put everything back? I'll... I'll keep an eye on it.
